name: Beszel servers
author: skoom
description: Server health from a Beszel hub: one bar icon that turns urgent when a server drops or an alert fires, and one panel with per-server CPU, memory, and disk meters.

barWidget.description: Up-count in the bar; click for per-server meters, load, uptime, and firing alerts.

schema.label: Hub URL
schema.description: Your Beszel hub, e.g. http://localhost:8090. Leave blank to use the credentials file.

schema.label: Hub email
schema.description: The Beszel user account to read from. Leave blank to use the credentials file.

schema.label: Hub password (stored in plain text)
schema.description: Convenient but readable by anything that can read shell.json. To keep it out of shell.json, leave this blank and run the plugin's ./setup script instead.

schema.label: Credentials file
schema.description: Override the default ~/.config/beszel-status/config. Values set above win over this file, per field.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the bar icon re-checks the hub while the panel is closed.

schema.label: Refresh interval while open (seconds)
schema.description: Faster cadence while the panel is on screen so the meters move as you watch.
